📍The Product
⭐ PDRN Essence Stick Balm

What it is

Why PDRN

One-line summaryYour driest spot up close, one swipe of the PDRN Stick Balm, then the glow.

🖐️How to Apply

Twist it up and swipe straight on the dry spot. Hands in frame, close to the camera.

Any dry spot works: face, collarbone, elbows, heels, knees. You pick 2 or 3.

📸Content Concept

⭐ MUST HOOK → your driest spot up close: dry cheeks, cracked heels, rough or dark elbows

Content flow : dry spot close-up → "the weather changed and my skin looks like this" → lotion never lasts → swipe on your face → same stick on your body → the glow in the light

🎬How to Film It
Before & After face first → same stick on body → glow
Hook
"The weather changed and my skin looks like this."Open on your driest spot in a tight close-up. Heels, elbows, knees, anywhere that's dry or rough for you. The drier it looks, the better. Bare skin, no filter.
Problem
"Lotion soaks in and an hour later it's dry again."Stay on the dry spot. Run your finger over it so the rough texture shows.
Face
"So I switched to this PDRN stick balm."Hold the stick up, label to camera. Start on your face: swipe it over your cheekbones. Put FACE on screen.
Body
"And it's not just for my face."Use the same stick on your body: collarbone, elbows, heels. Swipe 2 or 3 dry spots and put each one on screen, like COLLARBONE or ELBOWS. Say what it does:
  1. PHYTO PDRN™ from wild ginseng → helps hydrate dry skin
  2. The balm melts on contact → goes on smooth and thin
  3. No greasy feel → just a natural glow
Proof
"Look at that glow."Before & After: go back to the spots you swiped, like your collarbone or cheekbones, and show the same spot glowing, turned to the light. That's the last shot.
✅Filming Rules
  • ⭐ Before & After is a must. Show the same spot before and after.
  • Open on your driest spot, up close.
  • Face and body both work: cheekbones, collarbone, elbows, heels.
  • Name each spot on screen, like FACE, COLLARBONE or ELBOWS.
  • Show the balm gliding on up close.
  • Bare skin, no filter.
  • 15 seconds or longer.
